notes: New Parts History tab — business intelligence from your own searches. Every time you compare prices for a panel or battery it's counted, building up over time: it shows which parts you look up most, how many times (all-time and last 12 months), when you last looked, which laptops each fits, and — the clever bit — which other part numbers it's cross-compatible with (learned from your own searches). Anything you've searched 3+ times gets a '📦 consider keeping in stock' nudge, so you can spot what's worth holding. One click re-runs the live price search for any part or its compatible alternatives. Also added a real gotcha you flagged: the SAME panel model number can ship different revisions with a different connector position/PCB size or 'with vs without brackets' — so there's now a warning on the results and in the help to match the revision and connector, not just the model number.
